prompt:

If the Player is outside, describe possible routes or tall grass. If there are NPCs or items in Pokéballs to be picked up, describe their location. If the Player is in a battle, describe the necessary details to make a decision including HP, opponent HP percentage, statuses, highlighted menu item, etc.
